purpose: Municipal regulations that hand a provision's content to the Social Welfare Act by the act's abbreviation ("SHS § 25"). The twin of tests/evaluation/graph/abbreviation-municipal-1.json: the same three questions, each with the Act's deciding words. No standing run includes it: choose it with --scenarios when a change touches the knowledge lane's candidates, the national-law reserve, the rerank or the following of act references. On 02.10.2026 only the Põlva question was run on the full route (it passed, once); the other two were measured in the search alone, without the rerank and answer models (docs/audits/rag-v2-abbreviation-references-2026-10-02.md). Three paid turns, about 0.02 USD at the plan's prices.

expectation_help.region: the municipality the conversation is about
expectation_help.evidence_text: the deciding provision's exact phrase is in the evidence the answer was given
expectation_help.cited: the answer cites the Social Welfare Act, not only the regulation that points at it
expectation_help.must: the answer states the deciding condition or its effect
expectation_help.must_not: the answer does not state the opposite

scenarios.title: Asendushooldusel lapse isiklike kulude miinimum Narvas
scenarios.source: Narva asendus- ja järelhooldusteenuse kord § 3 lg 1; SHS § 45¹¹ lg 3

turns.text: Minu õelaps on Narva linna kaudu asendushooldusel perekodus. Kui palju raha peab tema isiklike kulude jaoks kuus vähemalt kulutatama?
turns.note: The regulation guarantees "at least the minimum of SHS § 45¹¹ lõige 3"; the amount is only in the Act.

evidence_text: Lapse isiklike kulude katteks peab iga kuu tegema kulutusi keskmiselt 240 euro ulatuses

scenarios.title: Järelhooldus õppivale noorele Sillamäel
scenarios.source: Sillamäe asendus- ja järelhooldusteenuse kord § 5 lg 2; SHS § 45¹⁶ lg 1

turns.text: Olen 20-aastane, kasvasin Sillamäel asenduskodus ja õpin nüüd kutsekoolis. Kas linn peab mulle järelhooldusteenuse tagama ja kui kaua?
turns.note: The regulation guarantees aftercare to "the adult named in SHS § 45¹⁶ lõige 1"; who that is and until when is only in the Act.

evidence_text: esmase õppekavajärgse nominaalse õppeaja lõpuni, kuid mitte kauem kui isiku 25-aastaseks saamiseni

scenarios.title: Vanaema tugiisikuna Põlva vallas
scenarios.source: Põlva raske ja sügava puudega lapse tugiisikuteenuse kord § 4 lg 2; SHS § 25 lg 2 p 2

turns.text: Elame Põlva vallas ja mu lapsel on raske puue. Kas tema tugiisikuks võib olla lapse vanaema?
turns.note: The regulation lets the support person be "a person who meets the requirements of SHS § 25"; who may not provide the service is only in the Act. The same words stand in SHS § 29 lõige 2 (the personal assistant), so the phrase alone does not tell which section reached the evidence.

evidence_text: kes on teenuse saaja esimese või teise astme üleneja või alaneja sugulane
